recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. Remaining old wording is limited to generated-looking SVG titles and out-of-build SupplyRequest mapping metadata; those should be handled only by normal regeneration or external SupplyRequest reconciliation, not by manual core source edits for this issue.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive R5 request to clarify groupIdentifier by replacing ambiguous requisition-or-prescription wording with the approved definition explaining that the same Identifier ties together multiple independent Request instances authorized together.
initial_application: Git commit b5f0dcdffd applied FHIR-37966 to CommunicationRequest, DeviceRequest, MedicationRequest, RequestOrchestration, and Task, but the active Request logical pattern still had the old definition and later active resources reused similarly ambiguous wording.
additional_context: The Request logical pattern and ServiceRequest, NutritionOrder, and VisionPrescription resources are active build inputs. FHIR-38868 fixed nearby Request narrative naming, FHIR-50429 preserved ServiceRequest.requisition while keeping the Request.groupIdentifier mapping, and SupplyRequest is out of the active core build with its own external-repo audit.
reconciliation: Published a non-empty source commit updating Request.groupIdentifier plus ServiceRequest.requisition, NutritionOrder.groupIdentifier, and VisionPrescription.groupIdentifier to the approved wording, and synchronized active request-mapping exception metadata by removing no-longer-real definition mismatches.
source_changes: source/request/request-spreadsheet.xml: updated the active Request.groupIdentifier logical-pattern definition to the approved FHIR-37966 clarification.
source/servicerequest/structuredefinition-ServiceRequest.xml: clarified ServiceRequest.requisition, while preserving the ServiceRequest element name and Request.groupIdentifier workflow mapping.
source/nutritionorder/structuredefinition-NutritionOrder.xml: aligned NutritionOrder.groupIdentifier with the approved clarification after it had been added later with older wording.
source/visionprescription/structuredefinition-VisionPrescription.xml: aligned VisionPrescription.groupIdentifier with the approved clarification after it had been added later with older wording.
source/*/*-request-mapping-exceptions.xml: removed or updated active groupIdentifier definition exceptions that became obsolete after the Request pattern and active resource definitions were aligned.

related_jiras.note: Request pattern narrative was separately corrected to use Request.groupIdentifier rather than requisitionId; it did not update the element definition.
